data.name: Basic/Intro To Freedive Course
data.headline: Age 15+ • Classroom & Pool Only • 2-Day Course
data.description: This will be your first step toward discovering why freediving is becoming a popular way to explore beneath the waves. No previous freediving course is required. This course teaches you about freediving principles and provides you with an introduction to the concepts and skills used by recreational freedivers. You learn basic freediving principles and focus on practicing breath-hold techniques in a pool. You will earn a certification recognition after successfully completing this program.

The PADI Basic Freediver course is a subset of the PADI Freediver course. It's a great first step for developing solid freediving skills. You learn basic freediving 

*Classroom & Pool Course Only*

data.highlights:
- Classroom/Knowledge development about freediving principles through independent study with the Freediver Academic Online Materials, as well as an Instructor-led classroom session.

- Pool/Confined water session to learn breath-hold techniques and static and dynamic apnea.

- Goal – static apnea of 90 seconds and dynamic apnea of 25 meters/80 feet.

data.what_to_bring:
- Towel, Swimsuit, swim shorts, sunscreen, water or favorite hydration drinks, and snacks.

- Pool Training Wetsuit - a 3 or 4/3 mm surf suit/triathlon swimsuit or similar is recommended for pool training. Please let us know if you cannot provide your own pool wetsuit.

- We do not require you to supply or own your own freediving gear for this course. During your classroom session with your instructor, you will learn about the importance of the various freediving equipment items and will be able to make a more informed purchase decision after the course.

data.booking_notes:
#*BASIC / TRY FREEDIVER COURSE

##Course Duration

• 2 Days

##Important Information

• Freediver Information Form
• Freediver Course Agreement Form
• To secure your spot in a course, your registration full payment is required.
• Our policy on drugs and alcohol is simple – ZERO TOLERANCE. Any use or suspected use will immediately terminate the dive without any refund.
• Rental equipment is available upon request. We do provide a complete rental fleet of all items.

##What to bring

• Swim-suit or swim-shorts
• Towel
• Sunscreen
• Hat
• Silicone or Latex swim-cap if you have long hair
• Lots of water or other favorite hydration drink
• Personal snorkeling equipment that you already own
data.special_requirements:
**Prerequisites**

- Be at least 15 years of age (with parental consent) or older
- You need adequate swimming skills and need to be in good physical health. NO prior experience with scuba diving, snorkeling, or freediving is required.
- Paperwork: Complete the PADI Medical Questionnaire, Freediver Liability Release, and the Statement of Understanding.
data.health_and_safety_notes:
If you currently suffer from asthma, heart or brain problems, high-blood pressure, lung injuries, diabetes, epilepsy, or any recent injury or taking any kind of prescription medication, (except both control or anti-malarial drugs other than mefloquine/Lariam), you will not be able to dive with us without the signature of a physicians authorization. Without this, your activity may be canceled without a refund on the day of your activity.

data.faqs:
**What is the PADI Basic/Intro To Freediver Course with Dive California?**

The PADI Freediver course is the first level of freediving and includes an instructor-led classroom session and, confined water (or pool) session.

**What is included in the PADI Freediver course with Dive California?**

- All necessary freediving gear
- PADI Freediver e-Learning study materials
- PADI e-certification
- Instructor-led classroom session
- Confined Water/pool session

**How long does the PADI Basic/Intro to Freediver Course take?**

Our PADI Basic/Intro to Freediver course will take a minimum of 3 days, allowing you to take the course at a relaxed pace.

**What is the minimum age for the PADI Freediver Course with Dive California?**

Minimum age for the PADI Freediver course is 15 years of age, in good health, and have adequate swimming skills.

**What should I bring?**

- Towel, Swimsuit, swim shorts, sunscreen, water or favorite hydration drinks, and snacks.

- Pool Training Wetsuit - a 3 or 4/3 mm surf suit/triathlon swimsuit or similar is recommended for pool training. Please let us know if you cannot provide your own pool wetsuit.

**Will I receive a certification?**

You will earn a certification recognition after successfully completing this program.
